arguments.text: Implemented work.py evaluate: filters by matching claim, non-withdrawn status, exact values for all policy-required request conditions, and verified=true when required; reports sorted missing conditions; applies supersession only among eligible records; compares values via canonical JSON without voting; preserves false as unsupported and absent evidence as unknown. Generated report.json from current fixtures. Local assertions covered filters, immutability, canonical object agreement, supersession, conflict/no-voting, false, absent evidence, and report parity.

Unresolved limit: task data assumes evidence records have string source IDs and JSON-serializable finite values; behavior for malformed records (missing source, NaN/non-JSON values, or non-list evidence) is unspecified and intentionally not invented.
